name: quenching
description: Marketplace hosting the plugins that install into no repository: quenching-hud, the band above the prompt that shows the worktree's active quenching spec, and quenching-cache, the prompt-cache band derived from cache-maxxing by 5m0k3. The quenching surface itself is not a plugin: it is installed into each target repository with `cq deploy`.

plugins.name: quenching-hud
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: the worktree's active quenching spec, its stage and task progress, read through cq specs status --no-fetch. Runs only git branch --show-current and cq specs status; writes no spec or branch and never fetches: it reads the local refs/remotes/origin/quenching, so the band can lag the remote.

plugins.name: quenching-cache
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: minutes left on Claude's prompt cache, the next message's estimated cost and one tip, in the repository's declared language, with settings from shared.cache through cq. /quenching-cache handoff writes quenching's handoff with Haiku (the expired chat is never resent) and stores it beside its spec; /quenching-cache stats reads cq components session cache. No network of its own. Derived from cache-maxxing by 5m0k3 (MIT, https://github.com/5m0k3/cache-maxxing).
